title: feat(pm): enforce the tier-and-effort rule when a claim is written and when a dev is dispatched
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-alice"} -->
_Requested by **Alice** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH?thread=cmsg_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePHEeQWcrM65WNZnsi1Bo8Tn7)_

Rule-change: yes

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;车队席位写认领、或派发开发子代理时,没写档位与力度、或力度与卡的大小对不上的,会当场被拒并被告知去哪里查定档规则。
- 为什么做:定档规则此前只靠自觉,出现过小卡按高力度认领、派发时不带档位与力度的情况;这是你在项目线程里选定方案的两个改动中的第一个(机器把关),第二个改规则文字。
- 出错会怎样:席位写认领或派发时会被多拦一次,照提示补上一行即可继续;派发拦截有本机开关可临时放行,整个改动可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:本改动含钩子与设置,属于须你亲手合并的一类,请审后合并。

## What changes

PR 1 of 2 (the mechanical half). PR 2 carries the skill text and the area-brief template; this diff touches neither `.claude/skills/**` nor `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`.

**A. Claim-write time** (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`)

A comment that OPENS with `Claim:` is refused before the write (exit refused, nothing sent, on both `post-stamped --comment` and the `label-write --comment-file` fold, which share `judgeBody`) when:

- it carries no `Container & model:` line;
- the line opens with no size token (`XS`, `S`, `M`, `L`, `XL`), or its `effort:` slot reads no value;
- the effort is not the size's table value and no `reason:` sits inside the effort slot (so `S` at `high` needs a reason; the model slot's `reason:` does not count);
- the effort is `xhigh` and the claim's `File surface:` names no `docs/adr/` path. No reason unlocks that one: the rulebook says the adversarial re-read's value goes to that subagent and is never written in a claim. On an ADR surface `xhigh` still carries its `reason:` (the standing order), as every off-table pairing does;
- the effort is a value the rulebook gives no card (`low`, `max`, a placeholder).

The table is ONE exported constant, `EFFORT_BY_SIZE`, beside `readContainerModelLine`; `post-stamped.mjs` imports it and the refusal like the existing four keys, and the spelling it prints is built from the constant. A freshness case in the dispatch-gates self-test re-reads the rulebook row in `execution-duties.md` and reds when the two disagree. `XS` is triage's vocabulary one step under `S`; the rulebook names no row for it and it reads as `S`.

Read time is untouched: `readContainerModelLine` and `containerModelRefusal` still pass absence, and a `Claim:` quoted further down a report is not judged for it. The case that pinned "absence is untouched" at the write tool is flipped, with a comment saying why write time differs.

**B. Dispatch time** (`.claude/hooks/guard-dispatch-tier.sh`, its `.selftest.sh`, `.claude/settings.json`)

A PreToolUse guard on matcher `Agent|Task`. When `tool_input.subagent_type` is `os-dev`, the call is blocked unless `tool_input.model` and `tool_input.effort` are both set and the prompt carries a `Container & model:` line whose effort equals the parameter. The refusal names what is missing and points at the rulebook section. Every other subagent type is allowed untouched; an unparseable payload is allowed through; `OS_ALLOW_UNTIERED_DISPATCH=1` in the hook's own environment is the deliberate exception, shaped like its siblings'.

Multi-repo project threads do not load a repo's `settings.json`, so this hook never runs there. The claim-time refusal (A) is the backstop for those: it lives in the write tools, not in the harness.

**Not built, proposed instead: the size-versus-triage comparison.** Neither write path reads the card's thread when a claim goes out (`post-stamped` reads the tail only on `--body`; the plain `label-write --comment-file` fold reads no comments), so comparing against the triage line is a new fetch on every claim. See Acceptance notes for the reading that also weakens its premise.

## Tests

Head `cb4756bc`. Every derived family from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` ran at that head; the reconciliation line:

`✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (0 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3, 2 claimed).`

<details><summary>The new cases, as the self-tests printed them</summary>

```
check:pm-dispatch-gates (fast tier; 2273 cases pass; 9 slow sections deferred to CI)
  ✓ ⭐ FRESHNESS: 定档's own row still reads S ⇒ medium and M、L、XL ⇒ high, and `EFFORT_BY_SIZE` equals it — XS riding on S
  ✓ ⭐ FRESHNESS: 定档 still caps effort at the table's top and gives the one value above it to the ADR-revision row, never to a claim's adversarial re-read
  ✓ readClaimEffort: the size is the FIRST token, the effort the first after its key, decoration stripped and case folded
  ✓ readClaimEffort: a `reason:` counts inside the effort slot only — the model slot's, before or after it, is its own
  ✓ ⭐ claimTierWriteRefusal: every size at its table value passes, and so does a reasoned exception
  ✓ ⛔ THE MEASURED SHAPES: S at `high` with no reason, no `effort:` value, and no line at all are each refused, naming 定档's file
  ✓ `xhigh` in a claim: refused off the ADR surface whatever the reason, refused on it without one, read on it with the standing order cited
  ✓ ⛔ control: the READ-time reader is untouched — a claim with no line, or no effort, still earns no `containerModelRefusal`
check:pm-post-stamped — ✓ post-stamped self-test: 807 cases pass across 30 batteries
  ✓ ⛔ WRITE TIME: a claim being made with no `Container & model:` line is REFUSED — while the same lines quoted under a report, and the read-time reader, are untouched
  ✓ ⭐ 定档 reads: S at `medium`, M at `high`, and a reasoned exception inside the effort slot
  ✓ ⛔ THE MEASURED SHAPES: an S card at `high` with no reason, an M card at `medium`, and a line with no `effort:` value at all are each REFUSED
check:pm-label-write — ✓ label-write self-test: 398 cases pass across 19 batteries
check:pm-close-cards — OK close-cards self-test: 228 cases pass across 20 batteries
.claude/hooks/guard-dispatch-tier.selftest.sh — guard-dispatch-tier selftest: 31 passed, 0 failed
the six sibling hook self-tests — each exit 0 (157 · 120 · 80 · 65 · 50 · 58 passed)
```

</details>

<details><summary>Readings taken against real data</summary>

- The Agent tool's input in this harness carries `model` and `effort` keys: read off this session's own transcript, two `Agent` calls, keys `description, effort, model, prompt, run_in_background, subagent_type`.
- Both real payloads replayed through the hook: allowed (exit 0); the same payloads with `effort` deleted: blocked (exit 2).
- The claim line on card 36052, replayed through `claimTierWriteRefusal`: refused with `size S reads effort: medium and the line says high with no reason: inside the effort slot`. Card 36053's claim has the same `S` plus `effort: high` shape.
- No ablation: the diff is tool scripts, hooks and settings, which the dev rules exclude from ablation; every new case asserts both directions (a body that reads and a body that is refused).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Incident 3 does not support the comparison as worded.** Card 36190's triage comment reads `· size S` and its claim reads `S`: the two agree, so a claim-versus-triage check would not have fired. The mis-sizing was upstream of the claim.
- **Freshness pin and PR 2.** The dispatch-gates self-test reads three pieces of `execution-duties.md` under its sizing heading: the row giving `S` its effort and `M、L、XL` theirs, the sentence capping effort, and the ADR-revision row with its "never written in a claim" clause. A rewording there must keep them or move the pin in the same PR. That is the point of the pin, and PR 2 edits that neighbourhood.
- **Every new claim now owes the line**, self-picked seat claims and re-claims included. The template already carries it; claims written from memory without it are refused with the spelling printed.
- **The tier reading for this diff** (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` at `cb4756bc`, 7 paths): "no path-derived mandate". The order's line cites a mandate; that reading belongs to the combined order, whose rule-text surfaces are PR 2's.
- **Commit trailers** are the repository's model-free pair, and the footer below is the repository's session-URL form; the order asked for other spellings of both.
- **Branch state:** opened 6 commits behind `origin/main` (`49c6bf3d`); none of them touches `scripts/**`, `.claude/**`, `.github/**`, `AGENTS.md` or `package.json`, and `git merge-tree` is clean.
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:i18n-coverage` answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET locally (exit 3: they read a built tree, and this diff touches no package); recorded NOT MEASURED, CI runs them. The dispatch-gates battery ran its fast tier locally; the slow tier is CI's.
- Size: 7 files, +336 / -16, net 320 lines against a budget of about 350.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, the `claimTierWriteRefusal` hunk: the refusal ladder. The risk is over-refusal: every claim written from now on needs the line, a size and an effort.
2. `.claude/hooks/guard-dispatch-tier.sh`, the `problems` block: the deny conditions. The risk is a harness that renames the `model` or `effort` input keys, which would block every `os-dev` dispatch until the escape hatch is set.
3. `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, the `claimKeyedLineRefusals` hunk: the scope. The new row runs only when the comment opens with `Claim:` and the ceiling row did not already file.

Two-minute check: run `.claude/hooks/guard-dispatch-tier.selftest.sh`. Expect a last line of `guard-dispatch-tier selftest: 31 passed, 0 failed` and exit 0.
